text:
Mira Patel: Heads up — after upgrading the us-west-2 control plane to k8s 1.27 this morning, cluster-autoscaler stopped spinning up GPU node pools for the `gpu-inference-*` nodegroups. Pods are pending with no scale event.
Raj Chen: Ugh, saw CPU nodes scale but GPU pools stayed at 0? Any errors in CA logs?
Mira Patel: This is what CA printed in staging: `scale-up: failed: node group not found for label: beta.kubernetes.io/instance-type` — looks like the old label is missing after upgrade.
ops-oncall: deploy-bot alerted about many pending pods in prod-gpu-queue at 09:12. I temporarily bumped replica counts on the CPU fallback job to keep latency down. :facepalm:
Kelly O'Neal: k8s removed some deprecated labels in 1.27; `beta.kubernetes.io/instance-type` is gone, CA was still matching that label in our nodeGroup discovery. We likely need CA config or a newer CA version that uses `node.kubernetes.io/instance-type` or `topology.kubernetes.io/zone`.
Raj Chen: Confirmed in our staging CA pod log: `Failed to discover nodegroups: missing label filter match (beta.kubernetes.io/instance-type)` — autoscaler we're running is `cluster-autoscaler v1.22.0`. That version predates the label migration.
Mira Patel: Proposed short-term workaround: manually add legacy label to GPU ASG launch template via user-data or node-init so CA can see them until we patch. Long-term: upgrade CA to v1.25+ which supports new label keys.
Kelly O'Neal: Manual label is risky across thousands of nodes. Alternative: update our CA discovery config to match instance metadata instead of label? But that needs testing.
Raj Chen: I built a quick patch to our CA helm values to accept both labels and fallback to instance-type annotation. Patch PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/merge/4821 (test branch: ca-multi-label-support).
Mira Patel: Nice. Can you also add a feature-flag so we can roll the change in staging first? Want canary in us-east-1 before prod.
Raj Chen: Yup. I'll open a canary rollout plan: 10% of GPU nodegroups in staging -> if stable, 50% in prod -> full. Will post rollout steps.
ops-oncall: For immediate mitigation, I ran:```kubectl label nodes -l node-role.kubernetes.io/gpu=true beta.kubernetes.io/instance-type=$(kubectl get nodes -l node-role.kubernetes.io/gpu=true -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.labels["node.kubernetes.io/instance-type"]}')``` That made CA discover the existing GPU nodes so it stopped complaining, but it's a one-off hack.
Kelly O'Neal: Add that command to the runbook under "k8s-1.27-upgrade-gpu-regen" and note it's temporary. Also schedule a nodegroup rolling update to ensure new nodes are created with correct labels once CA upgraded.
Mira Patel: Action items: 1) Raj — PR + canary rollout plan (ETA 2h). 2) Ops — runbook note and temporary label command in case other clusters hit this (ETA 30m). 3) Infra — schedule CA upgrade during low traffic window tomorrow.
Raj Chen: PR created and tested in staging cluster-3. CA now recognizes GPU nodegroups and created a node when I applied a pending GPU pod. Diff summary in PR.
deploy-bot: CI pipeline passed for infra/ca-multi-label-support (build #873). :white_check_mark:
ops-oncall: I'll coordinate with SRE for the canary at 11:30 PST. If anything flakes we'll rollback helm values.
Kelly O'Neal: Also flagging cost impact — until CA fixed, we had CPU fallback jobs running which increased tail costs ~18% in us-west-2 for the hour. Finance FYI.
Mira Patel: Good catch. Please capture exact numbers and tag for cost analysis.
Raj Chen: After canary, plan is to upgrade cluster-autoscaler across all regions to v1.25 and update discovery config to accept both legacy and new label keys for a 2-week transition. Then remove the legacy label workaround.
Mira Patel: Thanks — let's keep this thread for status updates. If anyone finds a different root cause (e.g., provider-specific CRD change), ping here immediately.
ops-oncall: Will post postmortem if we hit any production incidents. For now monitoring alerts suppressed for repeated pending-pod noise. :thumbsup:
Kelly O'Neal: Added note in #incidents and updated the k8s-upgrades calendar event with the CA upgrade window.
Mira Patel: Closing loop: CA patch deploying to canary now. I'll follow up when it's in prod. Thanks team. :rocket:
